quest.title: Wish-Fulfilling Treasure Hunt
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

dialogues.text: ...What are you looking at? Never seen an adventurer before?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what a coincidence. We're adventurers ourselves. What are you doing here?
We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.
#Hey! Why are you telling {M#them}{F#them} about it?
Oh... In that case, no, we are definitely not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You haven't been scammed, too, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you heard it from someone called Virgil, then, you've been lied to. There's no treasure. It's just a scam.
Ha! Like I'm gonna believe you! You just want to get us out of here so you can keep the treasure for yourself...
Do I look like a fool who just believes whatever someone says? I know what you're trying to do!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alrighty then. Good luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems that some lessons must be experienced to be learned...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Treasure... where could it be? In a chest? In a cabinet? Or tucked away in some hidden compartment?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I'm sorry, I can't remember what the treasure is. If only I could remember... then I'd be able to help out more.

dialogues.speaker: Precious Chest
dialogues.text: (It's a chest that looks like private property. Best not to touch it...)

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I see! Ball Octopuses' eyes brighten up when they see your physique. But why, then, would you join the Fleet?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Because rumor has it that sailors make big bucks. It'll bring a much more stable income than what we're doing, trying to find some secret treasure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there. What are you two doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Urville's doing physical training to join the Fleet... Joining the Fleet earns big bucks...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Nadia, I thought I told you to keep your mouth shut...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. I forgot again.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Hello, strangers. Urville is preoccupied with very important work, which is confidential, by the way. So, please leave us alone and keep your questions to yourselves.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We've met before, haven't we?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Is that so? I'm sorry, I don't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: She suffered cranial damage previously, and she's kept on forgetting things since.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: #Nadia, head back to shore with {M#them}{F#them} and rest a bit at The Rusty Rudder.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What about you? You don't look so good... Have you been...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: That's not the case. Training is tough. Urville has to complete all the training courses in order to join the Fontaine Fleet.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Ah, you know me so well, Nadia. Now, hurry up and go.

choices.text: Good luck with your training, then. We're off.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, let's not leave him here like that! Paimon feels he's just too embarrassed to ask for our help... You see, asking someone for help when you're in trouble isn't something to be ashamed of at all.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I—I told you I'm fine. Don't believe me? How about I do some push-ups right now?!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, stop moving, you'll flip the wooden planks!

choices.text: Stop trying to act tough when you don't even have an oar left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. Asking help from passing adventurers when you're in trouble is not something to be ashamed of.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: I didn't ask you to save me... How nosy. I'll just tell you upfront now — I have no Mora for you.

choices.text: Why are you scolding me after I helped you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We can't just ignore a person in danger... That's not called being nosy.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: That's too good to be true. I don't believe in kindness without agendas. I would've believed you more if I was some lovely damsel you'd come to save...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: But the fact is, I look like an odd-flavored candy without any wrapping from the city's candy store. No one would take a second look, let alone pick me up.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: If you didn't save me for Mora, then you must be up to something more sinister...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! This guy's head is so twisted... Paimon doesn't care if you believe us or not — we've always been bleeding hearts anyway. We didn't do it for Mora, but you at least owe us a "thank you"!

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Thank you, strangers, for helping Urville. I wanted to help, but I never could be of any help... I'm just useless like that.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Don't say that about yourself, Nadia...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, we forgot to introduce ourselves. Paimon's name is Paimon, and this is {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: D—Darn it, you want me to remember who I owe my life to, don't you?

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, but even if you tell me your names, I'd forget them soon enough...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Huh?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: ...I told you. She's suffered cranial damage, so she often forgets things. Don't judge her by how she is now. She used to be an elite at the Marechaussee Phantom, you know?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: But if it weren't for how she is now... She wouldn't have gotten mixed up with someone like me...

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Yes. Urville saved me when I was severely wounded, but I didn't have any Mora to give him, so I want to repay him by helping him... But I often forget things, and I can't remember if I've ever been of help...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Don't worry, you've helped me out lots. There are many things I would never have achieved otherwise alone by myself.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Is that so? I must've forgotten it. But, I'm happy to hear that I'm not so useless after all.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: If you want to collect your debt from us, can you wait until Urville is wealthy? Once we find the treasure, we'll be able to pay you back.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We're not collecting any debts! By the way, are you so fixated on finding the treasure and getting rich because you owe a lot of debts...?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: To be honest with you... it's for her treatment. You've seen it yourselves how serious her forgetfulness is...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Just so you know, she used to be called Knowledgeable Nadia, and she could remember everything.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: A full recovery is nearly impossible, but I want her to be able to return to a normal life at the very least... Even so, the medical expenses are going to be huge.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I am neither knowledgeable nor masterful, so all I can do is bet on luck. But I must say, my luck on bets has been very consistent. I have never won a gamble.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I thought I'd be able to find something of value inside or near that tower, but as it turned out, all I could find were shells and octopuses... and those octopuses even stole some things off us...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Not only did I lose my coin pouch and adventurer's gear... Even the diving set I rented from Pitot has sunk into the water... Haha... I'm really out of options.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You're suddenly quite the talker...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: That's because I'm despicable. I figure that if I say all these things, kind people like you wouldn't have the heart to ask me for things in return, right?

choices.text: You wish! I'm putting it on your tab.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Not a problem. I can dive. I can retrieve Urville's coin pouch and diving set, so we can repay our debts and start over.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Besides that, my token is missing as well. It probably also fell into the water, and I need to go search for it.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: What!? You should've said that from the beginning! A Melusine's token is really important! Much more so than the coin pouch or diving set...

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Is that so? I still don't fully understand, but I get it. I was afraid to delay your training. If you can't finish your training, you can't join the Fontaine Fleet.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: L—Let's not talk about joining the Fleet. Are you okay diving by yourself? What if you run into those octopus robbers...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, why don't we go with Nadia? It doesn't feel right to leave her to dive into the water to retrieve all those things by herself.

choices.text: Your coin pouch is fine. And it will be mine.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I knew it... Never mind, as long as you can protect Nadia and retrieve her token... The coin pouch is nothing...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME} was just messing with you!

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Now that you're helping with retrieving our missing items, can you also try to find my <color=#00E1FFFF>other things, like my tripod</color>... They should be <color=#00E1FFFF>in the water near where we originally set up camp</color>...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure thing... No point in doing only half a favor.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Well, thank you... Thank you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you forget Paimon already, Nadia? That was quick! Anyway, Paimon's name's Paimon!

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I got it now. You are Paimon. Thank you, Paimon.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Be safe! I'm counting on you then.

choices.text: After all, the motto is "we can't sit idly by."
That's still not gonna change your current predicament.
I don't expect anything in return for helping someone out.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: After all, our motto is "we can't sit idly by."

dialogues.speaker: Precious Chest
dialogues.text: (Looks no different from any other treasure chest.)

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Hey! What're you doing!? That's private property!

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: ...What are you looking at? Never seen an adventurer before?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, what a coincidence. We're adventurers ourselves. What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: We're looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum. It's gonna make us rich, Urville said so.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: #Hey! Why are you telling {M#them}{F#them} about it?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Oh... In that case, no, we are definitely not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thank you for informing us of the situation.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Darn... Well, even if you know, we were still here first. We'll definitely take the lead...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhh... But we...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Sorry, she suffered cranial damage previously, and she's kept on forgetting things since. What she says is not very coherent...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: #Right. Nadia, head back to shore with {M#them}{F#them} and rest a bit at The Rusty Rudder.

choices.text: Stop trying to act tough when you don't even have an oar left.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right. Asking help from passing adventurers when you're in trouble is not something to be ashamed of.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: You want to check on how we're progressing? I'm not telling you a word.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Sorry... but we are not looking for the treasure left behind by the Liliacruces Forum.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Nadia's token is the most important thing, followed by my diving set... As long as I have it, I can dive. It's not to say that everything else is not important, it's just that...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: The coin pouch... I—I do want to repay you for your troubles... But it's so little that I don't think you'd care for it...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Nervous? I'm hardly nervous at all!

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: How's my hair? How do I look? I'm not gonna embarrass myself by leaving something humiliating behind again, am I?

talks.objective: Return to The Rusty Rudder to find Urville

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back! Let's count... We found Nadia's token, the tripod, and the diving set, which is sadly a bit damaged... Oh, and we found your coin pouch, too!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Which did you lose? A coin pouch that's full of Mora or one without any?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: C'mon, stop messing around. We only found one, so let's just return it to him. The Mora's for Nadia's treatment, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Yes. It's not much, but thank... thank you for retrieving it for me.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: It feels... heavier than before...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Is it because... we robbed those Ball Octopuses in return?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Ugh... my arch-nemesis was so easily defeated by you two? You're no ordinary people for sure...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Arch-nemesis? You mean the Ball Octopuses?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Yeah, during the time that Nadia and I set up camp here, we had clashes with them every time we went diving... There was no winning side. We were evenly matched, you could say.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: I made it my goal to defeat those worthy and admirable opponents myself... But I didn't expect you to take them down like that...

choices.text: Sorry. Looks like I've interrupted your goal.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: By the way, I found a piece of paper from my earlier ventures while you were down there. It's been on my person, so it didn't get wet.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: But I can't understand a word of what's written on it. Maybe an adventurer with vast knowledge like you could decipher it.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I bet this thing is highly valuable. Consider it a token of my gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll gladly accept it.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: We also found this beautiful conch in the sea. Urville, please accept it.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Oh, thanks.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Urville takes the tiny conch and examines it...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Strange. This conch resembles the one from your hometown, isn't it? No wonder you find it pretty. What's the word? Nostalgia? Does it remind you of home?

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Well, not exactly. I had forgotten about it before, just like everything else, but when I saw it, I remembered. I saw it somewhere else, too. It's smaller than the one at Merusea Village, but bigger than this one.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: It's a collector's item from a researcher who studied many things. Unlike Urville, he has vast knowledge and a lot of Mora.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: But that was from a long time ago. He left many legacies, like the underwater shelter. I remember someone saying that there was treasure hidden there.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: But who said it...? I'm sorry. I can't remember.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're always apologizing, but it's not your fault. You don't have to apologize.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: That's right! You're truly incredible, Nadia! Of course, it'd be even more incredible if you could remember where this treasure-filled underwater shelter is...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In the end... all you care about is still treasure!

choices.text: Do you even have a heart!?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: That's right. I am despicable. Caring about treasure is how I really am! At least I'm honest! I want all the treasures, whether it's the legendary treasure or the legacy of that researcher! I want them all! I want to get rich!

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: If I was rich, I would be able to find the best doctors for Nadia... Then, she wouldn't have to live with a homeless person like me...

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: You'll get rich, Urville, and we won't have to live like this anymore. I can't remember the precise location, but I think I do have an idea of where this underwater shelter is.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Then what are we waiting for? Despite the damage, the diving set still has one functioning oxygen tank, which should be enough for a dive.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, should we go, too? Paimon's so curious about the treasure...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Both of you should come! You've helped us out a lot, so when we find the treasure, I'll definitely give you a share... no, two shares!

choices.text: I was also about to ask if she knows the location...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Oh, no... When did you become a heartless adventurer, too, {NICKNAME}...?

choices.text: It's okay. You can exact vengeance on me instead.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whether Urville can defeat you is one matter, but you can't really accept substitutes when exacting vengeance...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: This is the place. I remember being here before.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Is there really treasure here? This place doesn't feel special at all...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Impressive. Deeming this kind of place not worth your attention based on experience and knowledge. Just like how easily you defeated my arch-nemesis... Now that I've seen how you work first-hand... I'm impressed.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: One is quite all right, but I don't have confidence that I'll escape from a whole group of Fontemer Aberrants. Thinking back, I did get surrounded by a group of Ball Octopuses when I was small, and I nearly drowned.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: It was fortunate that a kind-hearted Melusine saved me and took me to a luxurious room... much like the one we're standing in.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You really do have quite a connection with the Melusines.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: True. The Melusines are nice to me. But I don't have much of a connection with humans... Guess that evens things out.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Never mind all that. Let's focus on getting rich!

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Let's split up and see if we can find the legendary treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (It takes you some effort to open the chest, but inside, there is only dust and powdery remains of... whatever the chest used to hold. Better not think about it.)

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (By looking upwards to the point where your neck cannot bend back any further, you finally manage to make out some books that look interesting, but they have nothing to do with research whatsoever.)

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (There are some yellowed blank sheets of paper and numerous empty ink bottles in the drawer.)

dialogues.speaker: Investigate
dialogues.text: (There seems to be something beneath the laid out sheet music...)

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What is this? The handwriting is barely legible... almost like a child wrote it... How strange, what it says seems oddly familiar... Could this be a coincidence?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, you're so kind... just like Urville.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Will we really find treasure here? We haven't found anything... besides a strange message that looks like it was written by a child...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: We didn't find anything either. That strange message... may be a clue left behind by the researcher! You know how rich people like to do these fancy things...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You give the message to Urville...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Huh, you're right. It can't even be called writing. It's more like a child's scribblings...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What, did you find anything?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: I found the treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? So this thing really did hold clues to the treasure? Paimon couldn't tell at all...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: How should I put it... but the last line of the ugly handwriting says...

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: "Today's experience is a treasure to me. The Melusine is so nice to me. When I grow up, I want to be someone who helps others, too."

choices.text: So this message was your...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Enough... You must be laughing hard inside... Haha... I can't believe something so embarrassing came from me.

choices.text: The handwriting is ugly, true. But what you said was right.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now that you put it this way, it really is something only a sincere and kind child would say! But what happened in the following years that turned Urville into such an awkward grown-up...?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: By the way, Paimon just remembered, didn't Nadia say that she "heard" someone say that there's treasure here?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And there's only one Melusine in this story, the one that saved Urville! Urville, do you still remember the Melusine who saved you all those years ago?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: All Melusines look kinda the same... How could I tell? Besides, I even forgot that I've left something so embarrassing here...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then... How about you, Nadia? Did anything here remind you of your past?

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I'm sorry. I can't remember.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You still can't remember? Oh, and Paimon thought there'd be a super happy ending to this story...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I don't know what kind of story you're expecting, but I'm definitely not some sort of protagonist. So, please, stop forcing Nadia to remember things.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I can't live up to your expectations, or the expectations of my younger self, for that matter... I've grown up, but not for the better. I still can't help anyone.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: To think that I even promised to split the treasure with the both of you... Hahaha... Should I rip this piece of garbage up for you, then?

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Urville, you've already saved me from certain death, and you're still trying to help me. It's just a temporary run of bad luck that you're having, and that I'm also forgetful...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Even if you didn't get rich today, you've still gained something.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Yeah. We helped you retrieve your precious memory, Urville, and that is the most valuable treasure. You should know that.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: But it's not worth anything... I can't pay for your treatment...

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: It's okay. It's just a temporary run of bad luck. Just get a grip on yourself, Urville. Keep a long face like that and even good luck will be driven away.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, sorry for making you come all this way for nothing. But, can I ask you for one more favor?

choices.text: Let's hear it.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: Can I please ask you to take a photo for me and Urville? If I have a photo, I'll be sure to remember what happened today whenever I see the picture.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I want to remember how the two of you helped us out, and that Urville needs to pay you back when he gets rich.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No need to remember that! But, if a picture is all you want, that's a piece of cake!

choices.text: Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: I haven't even said it...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Those words rolled off the tongue, just like that... Scary!

choices.text: No worries. We've all gone through our own awkward years.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Why are you saying that like you're old when you seem so young yourself? You're embarrassing me even more!

choices.text: So there is no valuable treasure here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Y—You can't really say that! Well, Those words are priceless to him, aren't they?

talks.objective: Take a picture for Urville and Nadia

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ready? Do you want to pose or something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Urville might look better sitting down. What should the background be?

choices.text: Sit in the middle of the long chair.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Alright... And Nadia will stand beside me. Is this alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, except for your rigid expression, everything else looks fine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, anyway! That'll be it, then. Say cheese!

choices.text: Sit on the single chair.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I doubt I'd fit with my divesuit on...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It feels cramped... You might as well just stand.

choices.text: Sit on the round chair.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: You serious? Why not ask Nadia to sit? Go on, Nadia.

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: No. Urville, you sit.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. I'll treasure this photo... and remember how much you've helped us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, by the way, you've remembered Paimon's name for a while now!

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: #Yes. Now, I know. Paimon must be as important to {NICKNAME} as Urville is to me.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Come on... You're embarrassing me.

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: But... I have to thank you for retrieving the tools for my trade. And now that I can dive again...

choices.text: You gonna keep looking for treasure?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Of course! Why would I stop?

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: Being able to find treasure or not aside, if I gave it up, I would be giving up the possibility of ever getting rich.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: That said, I could probably go find a stable job at Lumidouce Harbor... or perhaps be a maid in The Rusty Rudder?

choices.text: That's a bit of a stretch.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's hard to imagine...

response.speaker: Nadia
response.text: If that's the case, why don't you go work at Lumidouce Harbor, and I can go be a maid at The Rusty Rudder? Two salaries will hasten our road to great wealth!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That seems even more wrong!

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: #Haha! Anyway, thank you, {NICKNAME}, Paimon. You're good people, just like the Melusines.

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: I hope that the next time we meet, I'll already have become wealthy, and Nadia will have fully recovered from her injuries. I hope you will have also found whatever it is that you're looking for, too!

choices.text: You've certainly considered many different career paths.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon would say too many!

choices.text: Better just forget about treasure...

response.speaker: Urville
response.text: That's asking me to give up on getting rich. No way.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You then save Urville, who fell into the water, and return to the shore with Nadia before settling down for a break at The Rusty Rudder.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Urville, the Ball Octopuses' eyes just lit up. Why is that?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: Because they are envious of my physical constitution. I'll be able to join the Fleet if I keep my training up. They don't even have a chance.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is the place. Now, we need to find <color=#00E1FFFF>Nadia's token and Urville's equipment — his diving set, coin pouch, and something like a tripod</color>...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh. But what does Nadia's token look like?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: It's a tiny cog.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh...? We need to find a tiny cog in the vast ocean? But there might be all sorts of unrelated components sitting at the bottom of the ocean...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: It's fine. My eyesight is great. I'd be able to remember as soon as I see it.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: There are many Ball Octopuses around. The Ball Octopuses here and Urville are very alike.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Why do you say that?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Well... Because they all tend to act tough to try to intimidate their opponents. And, that they all like to collect shiny treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: The Ball Octopuses might've hidden our stuff inside the shells...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That must be the tripod all tangled up there... There should be a way to get it out, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: #Got it! There's no way I'd have been able to get it back by myself... Thank you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Found it! That's my token.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You really found it? It looks like just any other cog... Paimon can't tell the difference.

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: You can if you're a Melusine. I'm not quite sure why, so I'm afraid I can't teach you how, sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, there's no need to apologize...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So many Ball Octopuses! And Mora, too! Can we keep them? Can we?

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: Would the Ball Octopuses agree?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And what's this...

dialogues.speaker: Nadia
dialogues.text: I'm sorry. I can't remember. Maybe it's something we've lost. Maybe not.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's take it for now. Maybe we'll find some use for it!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That took quite a long time... We're more or less finished here. Shall we go back to The Rusty Rudder?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's the Ball Octopuses from before! Are they chasing us because we stole from them?

dialogues.speaker: Urville
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! I charge you with the mission of defeating my arch-nemesis!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No sign of any treasure... Let's see if Urville has had any luck.

dialogues.speaker: <UNKNOWN>
dialogues.text: You then save Urville, who fell into the water, and return to the shore with Nadia before settling down for a break at The Rusty Rudder.
